source: bu regulator status reads (board ADC and loop telemetry) during the 2026-10-15 session, transcribed from the session log; not a scripted capture. Load: 25 ohm fixed on VBUS, QT Py buck load not armed. Supply 24 V.
fields: v_out_mv: board ADC (VD_MON); i_cmd_ma: the loop's average output-current command; i_max_ma: its ceiling at that operating point; i_pk_ma: modelled peak inductor current; t_on_ns: charge pulse; sr_window_ns: rectifier on/off from the period start

runs.build: 17:12 interim: peak limits buck 6 A, buck-boost 8 A, boost 10 A; PDOs 3 A; 2 s cap above 28 V
runs.before: On arrival the regulator was latched in SW_UVP with VBUS at 0 V: it had been left on the 28 V EPR contract when the 25 ohm went on.

points.note: command at its ceiling, VBUS stalled at 22.7 V; the sink's transition timer ran out and it sent Hard Resets (three, then a detach and a new request), back to 20 V by request
EPR contract accepted (PS_RDY sent), then VBUS sat at 22 V in boost. Mode log: buck-boost -> boost at setpoint 27.49 V with V_out 27.34 V; boost -> buck-boost only when 20 V was requested

runs.build: 17:19: buck-boost up to V_in + 7 V, boost falls back on a sag, PS_RDY waits for the ramp, Hard Reset if VBUS stays 8 % low for 200 ms
runs.after: Q1-Q4 reported hot by touch after the 28 V run; parked at 5 V (V_out 4984 mV, I_cmd 372 mA).

runs.build: 17:52/17:54: rectifier build (Timers C/D edges, explicit Q4, preload), regulator_sr_enable 0
runs.after: At 5 V (I_cmd 375 mA, capture sr0_buck5 19:14) regulator_sr_enable was written 1 with no fade-in: within a second the regulator latched SW_OVP. Fault snapshot: V_out 5519 mV, setpoint 5000 mV, 1121 pulse-skip transitions. The capture sr1_buck5 (19:14:40) was taken after the fault, with the outputs off.

runs.build: 19:16: 100 ms rectifier fade-in (window, model diode term, Q3 start); pulse skipping in buck also stops Q4

points.note: requested from 28 V; a screech was heard; the 2 s cap sent a Hard Reset (pd_bench_high_v_resets = 1) and the sink came back at 5 V SPR

runs.after: Q1-Q4 reported cooler by touch at 28 V with the rectifier on than in run C.
